dataset: LoveDA expanded source and fresh Urban subset
pairing_note: Three paired model/selection seeds across methods; not a Cartesian variance decomposition
budget_rounding: ceil(N*f), unique cumulative fixed-size patches; report exact fractions
primary_metric: fixed-seven-class mIoU; empty-union IoU=0, fixed denominator seven
secondary_metric: ground-truth-supported mIoU with explicit class support, per-class IoU, accuracy
model: official ImageNet ResNet18 U-Net and NVIDIA MiT-B0 SegFormer with fresh semantic head
adapt_checkpoint: Each budget retrains from same source-best; round query uses previous adapted checkpoint
augmentation: horizontal/vertical flip and 90-degree rotation, same seeded RNG per paired run
precision: bfloat16 autocast on CUDA; loss float32; strict deterministic torch algorithms
source_stop: source validation mIoU early stopping only; best checkpoint; convergence diagnosed not assumed
evaluation_barrier: both architectures complete their entire adaptation matrix before any target evaluation
development_policy: predeclared evaluation, no hyperparameter search in this batch; all target development labels charged as separate research supervision
query_scope: fixed 256x256 nonoverlapping blocks; no claim of faithful whole-algorithm reproduction for literature acquisition adaptations
status: frozen before formal training; independent prepared-source support and mapping audit passed
cai_spatial_normalization: uncertainty full-pool minmax; spatial theoretical [0,2] to [0,1]
geographic_threshold: one query patch side in metres; L-infinity, geometric mean area-derived widths
source_region_policy: fixed source SHA order; support-gated batches of32 additional Rural train/val originals
optimizer_note: AdamW weight_decay=.01 on ndim>1; no decay for bias/norm; source 200-step warmup then cosine through12000 and constant tail through18000
source_selection: seed2026 only compares recipes using source-val eligible(all class IoU>=.01) then fixed-class mIoU; selected recipe frozen for other seeds
source_gate: all classes learned >=.01 at selected checkpoint AND six eval intervals without .002 eligible-score improvement after min6000; not a generalization guarantee
source_support_gate: >=20 train/5 val originals each with>=1024 class pixels; >=65536/16384 total class pixels per class
loss_weights: source frequencies only: sqrt(median(f)/f) clipped[.5,5] then mean-normalized; weighted CE divides by sum valid pixel weights
source_sampling: balanced component uniform class then uniform source patch with >=256 class pixels, fallback any positive; remaining uniform patch; shuffled batch
excluded_previous_target_originals: baseline/prepared_loveda/manifest.json all old Urban pool/test originals
backend_note: SegFormer uses forward-only compile reduce-overhead, NCHW contiguous, cudagraph step marker for every train/eval/query batch; strict deterministic BF16. Within-backend replay verified; not bitwise equivalent to eager.

random_definitions.uniform_random: historical quota-balanced random; pick from least queried originals with seeded patch-order tiebreak
random_definitions.original_uniform_random: at each draw uniform over originals with unqueried patches, then uniform remaining patch; original counts unconstrained
